result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found 3 minor issues related to text truncation and content overflow on horizontally scrolling elements.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal overflow.
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for a horizontal carousel, but ensure the partial card provides a clear affordance that more content can be scrolled into view.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramei' appears truncated and may be missing its final character ('Ramen') due to the star rating element overlapping the available space.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with an ellipsis and ensure adequate spacing between the title and the rating badge to avoid awkward cut-offs.

issues.description: The second item under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only a portion of the card.
issues.suggestion: This is normal for a scrollable list, but verify the card fully renders when scrolled and that spacing above the bottom navigation bar is consistent.
